clue.text: Word of hesitation in record large sum

indicators.note: the hesitation word is placed inside the record, so 'in' signals containment

parts.note: LP is a long-playing record
UM is what a speaker says while hesitating

explanation.surface: A speaker stammers over announcing a big figure on a recording.
explanation.definitionFit: A lump sum is a single large payment, so the word alone can stand for a large amount of money.

clue.text: Yearns to see fellow in underwear

indicators.note: the fellow's name sits inside the word for yearns, so 'in' signals containment

parts.note: to yearn is to long; yearns gives longs
JOHN is a typical man's name standing for any fellow

explanation.surface: Someone longs to catch sight of a man wearing only his smalls.
explanation.definitionFit: Long johns are warm close-fitting underpants reaching to the ankles, a kind of underwear.

clue.text: Choice flower that's an investment

parts.note: a preference is the choice one favours
stock is a scented garden flower

explanation.surface: A chosen bloom turns out to be a sound financial holding.
explanation.definitionFit: Preference stock is a class of shares paying a fixed dividend ahead of ordinary shares, an investment.

clue.text: One takes a backward view in it

definitions.text: One takes a backward view in it

parts.words: One takes a backward view in it
parts.note: the clue reads like a puzzle about a rear-facing seat or mirror, but describes the mental state of looking back over past events

explanation.definitionFit: Retrospect is the act of surveying the past, literally a looking back.

clue.text: Deserter had revolutionary square toothed bar

parts.note: a rat is one who deserts a cause, like rats leaving a sinking ship
CHE Guevara is the crossword's stock revolutionary
a T-square is a drawing instrument, so square gives T

explanation.surface: A turncoat owned a radical's carpentry tool with teeth.
explanation.definitionFit: A ratchet is a bar or wheel with angled teeth that a pawl engages, letting movement go one way only.

clue.text: Skin treatment centre

parts.note: reads as a beauty clinic or dermatology unit, but the skins are animal hides being turned into leather

explanation.definitionFit: A tannery is a works where animal hides are treated with tannin to make leather.

clue.text: Make a pig of oneself on the other side each time

parts.note: over means across, on the far side

explanation.surface: Someone across the way gorges themselves at every opportunity.
explanation.definitionFit: To make a pig of oneself is the idiom for gluttony, eating far too much.

clue.text: Moorland photograph includes lake showing perfect fitness

indicators.note: the lake's letter is taken inside the phrase for the moorland photograph, so 'includes' signals containment

parts.note: a photograph of moorland is a picture of heath
L is the map abbreviation for lake

explanation.surface: A snapshot of open moor with a lake in it is said to show glowing wellbeing.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone described as the very image of good condition is said to be this, an idiom for perfect fitness.

clue.text: Keep tractor perhaps

definitions.meaning: a keep is the strong central stronghold of a castle
a tractor is an example of something that tows, a puller

explanation.definitionFit: A castle keep is a fortified stronghold, while a tractor pulling a load is one that tows.

clue.text: All the food remains as announced in Warwickshire

indicators.note: the phrase is spoken aloud and the town name sounds like it

parts.note: if all the food remains, none has been eaten

explanation.surface: A report from Warwickshire says every scrap of the meal is left over.
explanation.walkthrough: NUNEATON is a market town in Warwickshire, a county in the English Midlands.
explanation.definitionFit: The town lies in the north of Warwickshire, so the clue defines it by its location.

clue.text: Avoid backing small school included

indicators.note: the school's abbreviation is put inside the reversed word, so 'included' signals containment
backing means the word for small is read backwards

parts.note: wee is Scottish for small

explanation.surface: Steer clear of supporting a tiny school that has been brought in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' turns the word for small round before 'included' puts the school inside it; wee is a Scots and everyday British word for small.
explanation.definitionFit: To eschew something is to deliberately avoid or abstain from it.

clue.text: Jay's misplaced hopes for carpenter

parts.note: jay is the spelt-out name of the letter J

indicators.note: the letters of hopes are put in the wrong places, rearranged

explanation.surface: A jay has lost track of its ambitions while a woodworker looks on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'misplaced' shuffles only hopes; the jay is the bird's name doubling as the spoken name of the letter it stands for.
explanation.definitionFit: Joseph, husband of Mary in the Gospels, was a carpenter, so he is the famous example.

clue.text: Fellow working with a will

parts.note: reads as a man working with determination, but the will is a legal testament he carries out

explanation.definitionFit: An executor is the person appointed to carry out the terms of a dead person's testament.

clue.text: No hope of confining surprised expression

indicators.note: the run of letters is held within the words No hope

explanation.surface: With no hope of locking it up, someone gasps in astonishment.
explanation.definitionFit: Oho is an exclamation of surprise or triumph.

clue.text: Interjection of annoyance when sacred snug retreat is surrounded

indicators.note: the snug retreat is enclosed by the word for sacred, so this signals containment

parts.note: holy means sacred
a nest is a cosy hideaway

explanation.surface: Someone exclaims crossly when a holy hideaway is hemmed in.
explanation.definitionFit: Said in exasperation, the word works as an exclamation of irritation, much like 'really!'.

clue.text: Much bid for

definitions.meaning: the phrase means everything, a great deal taken together
at an auction one bids for a numbered lot, and a buyer may bid for the whole lot

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means everything collectively, and at auction the lot is what one bids for.

clue.text: Four identical notes about a get-together

indicators.note: the four notes go around the A, so 'about' signals containment

parts.note: TE is a note of the sol-fa scale, so four of them give TE TE TE TE

explanation.surface: A quartet of matching musical notes surrounds a social gathering.
explanation.definitionFit: A tete-a-tete is a private conversation between two people, an intimate get-together.

clue.text: Joined, gently removed cut

indicators.note: the musical letter for gently is taken out of the word for joined

parts.note: spliced means joined, as ropes or film are
P is piano, the musical direction to play softly

explanation.surface: Two pieces were joined, then carefully separated with a cut.
explanation.walkthrough: P stands for piano, the musical instruction to play quietly or gently.
explanation.definitionFit: Sliced means cut, as bread is cut into thin pieces.

clue.text: Partly clearing part of the countryside

indicators.note: only part of the word clearing is used, the run of letters inside it

explanation.surface: A woodland clearing is a bit of rural landscape.
explanation.definitionFit: A lea is a meadow or grassy field, a poetic term for a piece of open countryside.

clue.text: Help up then hit up taking nothing from game

indicators.note: in a down entry 'up' means the word for help is read backwards

parts.note: aid means help

indicators.note: again 'up' in a down entry means the word for hit is reversed

parts.note: to lob is to hit a ball high
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Lend a hand, then strike upwards without scoring in a sport.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' reverses each word in turn, as suits a down entry; 'taking' simply adds the nothing. Diabolo is a juggling game with a spool spun on a string between two sticks.
explanation.definitionFit: Diabolo is a game in which a two-headed spinning top is tossed and caught on a cord.

clue.text: Afro to be incorrect wearing no shoes

indicators.note: the letters of Afro to be are arranged wrongly, so they must be reordered

explanation.surface: Getting a hairstyle wrong while going about unshod.
explanation.definitionFit: Barefoot describes someone with nothing on their feet.

clue.text: One can step on it out of the wet

definitions.text: One can step on it out of the wet

parts.words: One can step on it out of the wet
parts.note: reads as a dry path in rain, but describes the mat one stands on when stepping out of a tub

explanation.definitionFit: A bath mat is the absorbent mat placed beside the tub to stand on after bathing.

clue.text: Not right to ask maiden at mass

indicators.note: the letter for right is not wanted, so it is removed from the word for ask

parts.note: to require is to ask or demand
M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over

explanation.surface: It is wrong to ask a young woman to attend church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not' drops the second R of REQUIRE, leaving REQUIE; a maiden in cricket is an over with no runs scored.
explanation.definitionFit: A requiem is a mass sung for the souls of the dead.

clue.text: Short distance behind river has included broken part of engine

indicators.note: the short distance comes after the rest, so 'behind' sets the order

parts.note: the CAM is the river flowing through Cambridge

indicators.note: the letters of has are broken up and rearranged

parts.note: FT, a foot, is a short distance

explanation.surface: A short way back from the river, a broken engine part has been put in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broken' rearranges only has; 'behind' puts the foot after the river and the rest. The Cam is the river of Cambridge in England.
explanation.definitionFit: A camshaft is the rotating shaft in an engine that opens and closes the valves.

clue.text: Smoke 101 fish

parts.note: CI is 101 in Roman numerals
a gar is a long-snouted fish

explanation.surface: A hundred and one smoked fish.
explanation.definitionFit: A cigar is something one smokes, so 'a smoke' can stand for it.

clue.text: Bird coming from that French 17 down

parts.note: que is French for that
the answer to 17 down, a meadow

explanation.surface: A bird emerges from a French meadow.
explanation.definitionFit: The quelea is a small African weaver bird that flies in huge flocks.

clue.text: Listen to dance round and see dancing partner

parts.note: a gig is a live music performance one goes to listen to
O is round in shape
LO is an old word meaning look, see

explanation.surface: Hear a dance tune, turn around and look at a companion on the floor.
explanation.definitionFit: A gigolo is a man paid to be a woman's escort or dancing partner.

clue.text: Principal route used by Lynne it is reported in US state

indicators.note: the sounded name goes inside the state, so 'in' signals containment

parts.note: Maine is a state in the north-east US

indicators.note: the name Lynne is spoken aloud, giving a short sound written differently

parts.note: the name Lynne is pronounced lin

explanation.surface: A main road used by a woman named Lynne is said to run through Maine.
explanation.definitionFit: A main line is the principal railway route between major places.

clue.text: Lowest possible boulder wild tot in mob removed

parts.note: a boulder is a large rock

indicators.note: the letters are thrown about wildly, rearranged

explanation.surface: A rampaging toddler surrounded by a crowd is taken away from a big stone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts the child inside the crowd before 'wild' rearranges the whole lot; 'removed' just links the pieces to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Rock bottom means the lowest point possible, as with prices or morale.

clue.text: Clearly it cannot be seen through in the heat

definitions.text: Clearly it cannot be seen through in the heat

parts.words: Clearly it cannot be seen through in the heat
parts.note: reads like a puzzle about something opaque, but describes the shimmer of mist that hot weather produces

explanation.definitionFit: Haze is a thin mist that hangs in hot weather and blurs visibility.
